title: OobsPreview
description: Better Obsidian preview in Qoder & VS Code: callouts, task markers, properties, wikilinks, embeds, highlights, tags, footnotes. Independent; not affiliated with Obsidian.

title: Alran Code
description: Ottili's AI coding agent for VS Code. Describe a task and it plans it, edits the files, runs your tests and keeps going — with Ottili Werk, Claude or your own model. Needs the Alran Code CLI.

title: Tidepool & Azalea Theme
description: A sea-glass aqua and a dusk azalea pink, each in a light and a dark cut: Tidepool Light, Tidepool Dark, Azalea Light and Azalea Dark.

title: Test QCS Playwright Automation Agent
description: Generate Playwright tests from Azure DevOps test cases via the ADO and Playwright MCP servers. Deterministic scaffolding, mismatch detection, prerequisite + ADO-origin checks; agent prompt loaded privately from Azure DevOps.

title: Threadline — Codex & Claude
description: Codex and Claude threads across accounts. Manual tags, drag-and-drop groups, priorities, usage, and parallel editor tabs.

title: Quran for Claude Code (Unofficial)
description: Unofficial community extension. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Read the Quran while Claude Code works — totally offline.

title: RustTempest
description: A pseudo-terminal wrapper for Rust Playground, allowing execution of Rust files without rustup installed.
